_about: Public Ed25519 keys that may sign the update feed (update_feed.py). The private key is an EC_SIGN_ED25519 key in Google Cloud KMS and never leaves it; add its public key with the output of scripts/angelo/sign_update_feed.py public-key --kms <key version> (doc/angelo/updates_and_reports.rst, 'Key ceremony'). Mark a retired key "revoked", never delete it. Empty: this build can't verify a feed, so the update check fails closed and shows nothing.
